title: Own Sandisk? Your Five Years Hinge On Memory Prices
summary: Our Nov 16 piece, What Just Happened To SanDisk Stock?, looked at a 5.6% fall on Friday, Nov 13, that came with no company news. The selling did not stop there. Sandisk fell another 8.6% on Monday, Nov 16, closing at $809.11. The broad market had a bad day too, with the S&P 500 down 1.9%. The stock now sits 65.3% below its record close of $2,335.00 on June 25. That raises the longer question: where could Sandisk be in five years.
